data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

data.l1_hook: Olha lá fora! Pegue o guarda-chuva! "raining cats and dogs"

native.tip: “raining cats and dogs” = chovendo a cântaros. Exemplo: “It's raining cats and dogs!”
native.caption:
